ServiceRequest.title: Service Request
ServiceRequest.description: A request for service from a user.

id.description: The unique ID of the request.

user.description: The name of the user requesting service.

requestTime.description: The timestamp when the request was made.

startTime.description: The timestamp when the service started.

endTime.description: The timestamp when the service ended.

rating.description: The rating given by the user.
